challenges.title: Mug on a saucer
challenges.brief: Our café client needs a hero prop for their online menu: a mug of coffee resting on its saucer. Build it as a single Three.js object that stands on the ground at the origin with Y pointing up. The attached reference views are the exact target, so match them as closely as you can: the blue mug's gentle taper, how it sits on the saucer, the coffee just below the rim and the handle on the correct side all have to read at a glance from every angle. Keep it smooth and economical. Done means it could stand in for the reference without anyone noticing.
acceptance: Seen from the front, the top and both three-quarter views, it matches the reference.
The mug sits on the saucer, the coffee shows just below the rim and the handle is on the same side as in the reference.
Round parts look round, without visible facets, and nothing floats or pokes through anything else.
It uses about as many triangles as the reference, not many times more.

challenges.title: Small stone castle
challenges.brief: Create a compact stone castle with a central gatehouse, a taller keep, four roofed corner towers and a row of battlements. Add a small banner above the keep. Make the main shapes distinct and balanced as a single model. This is a single prop for a small scene. The attached reference is the target; use it to judge the silhouette, balance and relative placement of the parts. Keep the model upright, centered near the origin and resting on the ground. Make the major forms readable from the front and from a three-quarter view, with enough space around the shape to see its outline. Use clean, economical geometry and leave the camera and lighting to the viewer.
designNotes: stone curtain wall and central gatehouse
dark front gate and taller keep behind the wall
four corner towers with red conical roofs
small gold pole and red banner
